## Description
**P1 — App Files Search performs unbounded sequential remote directory enumeration and can present a truncated search as an authoritative negative result.** This is a post-closure residual defect distinct from accepted #1140 (mobile navigator and filename/path search) and #3451 (optional per-child count fan-out on ordinary directory navigation). Their acceptance did not exercise the independent Search BFS request budget or incomplete-result disclosure.

**Product journey:** In an active remote Session, open Files → Search to locate a file in a large Workspace. A tree with thousands of empty subdirectories triggers one Agent `file.list` per directory before Search becomes usable; a tree with more than 2,000 files can return `No files match` even if the sought file exists beyond the cap. The interface never says the result set is partial.

## Reproduction
1. Provide a deterministic `FileOps.listDir` fixture whose root has N non-hidden empty directories and no files; call `buildAppFilesSearchIndex(fileOps, signal)`. It makes N+1 sequential list calls despite `APP_FILES_SEARCH_MAX_FILES = 2000`.
2. Provide a fixture whose BFS traversal yields 2,000 files before a matching file in a later directory. Search completes with only the first 2,000; entering the latter filename yields `No files match`.
3. Open App Files Search with no query: `useAppFilesSearch` starts the same scan immediately and `AppFilesSearchPanel` renders Skeleton until completion.
4. Close Search while `listDir` is in flight: `AbortController` stops future BFS iterations only after that pending request resolves; `listDir(dir)` is not passed an abort signal. This is a cancellation limitation, not proof of an unbounded concurrent fan-out.

## Root Cause
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/appFilesSearchIndex.ts`: BFS `queue` grows from every visible directory; loop condition bounds only `files.length < maxFiles`, not directory visits, requests, elapsed time, or queue length; returns only `FileEntry[]` without completeness metadata.
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/useAppFilesSearch.ts`: eagerly indexes on `active`, stores no partial/truncated status and publishes `ready` after a capped scan.
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppFilesSearchPanel.tsx`: suppresses results during loading and emits unconditional `No files match` on an empty filtered subset.

**Verified:** the request count and false-negative path follow deterministically from the current main source. **Not verified:** production latency, actual timeout frequency or browser execution; do not claim an observed outage.

## Impact
Unbounded remote round trips on large/deep Workspaces delay a basic Session-first navigation action; false negatives mislead users about the current Workspace's files. This contradicts VISION.md's continuous work and PRINCIPLE.md's requirement to absorb infrastructure complexity.

## Fix Direction
Bound Search's traversal work at its owner (at least remote directory/request budget and termination semantics), expose completeness/truncation to the hook and App panel, and ensure empty results do not claim exhaustive absence when the scan is incomplete. Preserve current Session/FileOps scope, fuzzy filename/path matching and Search → Viewer navigation. Avoid new server-wide search protocols, speculative persistent indexing, unrelated Files navigator changes or cosmetic redesign. Cancellation should stop *new* requests; don't imply transport cancellation until supported by FileOps.

## Location
- [appFilesSearchIndex.ts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/appFilesSearchIndex.ts)
- [useAppFilesSearch.ts](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/useAppFilesSearch.ts)
- [AppFilesSearchPanel.tsx](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/app/experiences/app/AppFilesSearchPanel.tsx)
- Historical acceptance: #1140, #207; distinct fixed navigation fan-out: #3451.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A deterministic empty-directory fixture with arbitrarily many subdirectories terminates after a fixed documented maximum number of `listDir` requests, independent of directory count; no further requests launch after cancellation.
- [ ] SC-02 A fixture with a matching file beyond the traversal/file budget returns an explicitly incomplete result state, and App Search never displays an unqualified `No files match` for that state; a complete scan with no match retains the normal empty message.
- [ ] SC-03 On the App Search browser route, loading, partial-results disclosure, complete empty results and Search → Viewer selection remain distinguishable and usable at the canonical mobile viewport.

**SC → scenario mapping:** SC-01 → SCN-01 deterministic contract (controlled `FileOps` request counter, cancellation fixture, exact PR-head Web test/Gate); SC-02 and SC-03 → SCN-02 Web/App interaction (approved Chromium/Playwright browser Case with controlled FileOps fixtures, DOM assertions and exact SHA). SC-02 also needs deterministic source-level indexing fixture. No production latency SLO is asserted; a later benchmark would require SCN-06.

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |

| SC-01 | Pass | run 44004308572; ref 31b3b9773bd25fe3903c1f136e22f2682ace5b29; source agent-qwen; test: web/src/app/experiences/app/__tests__/unit/appFilesSearchIndex.test.ts:33-61 — 'bounds listDir requests by the documented directory budget, independent of directory count' tests empty-directory fixtures with 1,000, 10,000, and 50,000 subdirectories, asserting listDir is called exactly APP_FILES_SEARCH_MAX_DIRECTORIES (500) times for all three sizes; test: web/src/app/experiences/app/__tests__/unit/appFilesSearchIndex.test.ts:63-99 — 'launches no further listDir after cancellation, even while a request is in flight' verifies no requests to 'b' or 'c' after abort, with in-flight request handling; file: web/src/app/experiences/app/appFilesSearchIndex.ts:21 — APP_FILES_SEARCH_MAX_DIRECTORIES = 500, documented as 'Maximum number of listDir requests one Search scan may issue'; file: web/src/app/experiences/app/appFilesSearchIndex.ts:80-90 — Checks signal.aborted before each request (line 80) and requests >= maxDirectories before each request (line 84), returning incompleteReason 'cancelled' or 'directory-limit'; file: web/src/app/experiences/app/appFilesSearchIndex.ts:98-101 — Checks signal.aborted after each response, preventing further requests after cancellation; summary: Empty-directory fixtures with 1k/10k/50k subdirectories all terminate after exactly 500 listDir requests (the documented APP_FILES_SEARCH_MAX_DIRECTORIES constant), proving independence from directory count; cancellation checks before and after each request ensure no further requests launch after abort. Deterministic unit tests with controlled FileOps mocks verify the bounded termination and cancellation behavior at PR head. |
| SC-02 | Pending | Awaiting source-aligned Chromium Case proving partial vs complete negative results |
| SC-03 | Pending | Awaiting source-aligned Chromium Case proving App mobile search states and Viewer navigation |

## Prototype decision
**Not needed** — no new navigation paradigm or unresolved interaction model; use the existing App Search surface with a truthful partial-results state. Expected scenario: open Search on a large Workspace, observe bounded scan and incomplete-results disclosure. Browser Case is required to validate production behavior; no mock is claimed as proof.
